neighborhoods.name: South Reno
neighborhoods.description: Upscale suburban living with mountain views, top-rated schools, and easy access to Mt. Rose ski area.

neighborhoods.name: Midtown
neighborhoods.description: Walkable arts district with craft breweries, boutiques, and a vibrant food scene. Reno's cultural hub.

neighborhoods.name: NW Reno
neighborhoods.description: Established neighborhoods near UNR and Rancho San Rafael Park. Mix of historic and updated homes.

neighborhoods.name: NE Reno
neighborhoods.description: Growing area with new developments, Stead, and access to outdoor recreation north of the city.

neighborhoods.name: Sparks
neighborhoods.description: Family-friendly city with Victorian Square events, the Nugget, and more affordable price points than Reno.

neighborhoods.name: Spanish Springs
neighborhoods.description: Fast-growing suburban area with newer construction, good schools, and desert-meets-mountain views.

neighborhoods.name: Damonte Ranch
neighborhoods.description: Master-planned community in South Reno with parks, trails, and highly rated schools.

neighborhoods.name: Caughlin Ranch
neighborhoods.description: Prestigious gated community with panoramic city views, hiking trails, and luxury homes.

neighborhoods.name: Somersett
neighborhoods.description: Master-planned community in NW Reno featuring golf, fitness center, pools, and mountain views.

neighborhoods.name: Incline Village
neighborhoods.description: Lake Tahoe's premier community. Ski at Diamond Peak, beach access, and world-class recreation.

neighborhoods.name: Carson City
neighborhoods.description: Nevada's capital city offering affordability, historic charm, and proximity to Lake Tahoe.

neighborhoods.name: Minden/Gardnerville
neighborhoods.description: Carson Valley communities with stunning Sierra views, ranches, and a small-town feel.

neighborhoods.name: Dayton
neighborhoods.description: Historic Nevada town experiencing rapid growth with new construction and competitive pricing.

neighborhoods.name: Fernley
neighborhoods.description: Growing community east of Reno with some of the most affordable homes in the region.
